usedFor: Kanban Zone holds work cards, and HubSpot logs progress on a contact through “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Card Is Moved” in Kanban Zone, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each move across the board leaves a dated note, so sales sees where the client's work stands.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so each card must carry one.
